## Modules

- [Mob.Alert](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Alert.md): Native alert dialogs, action sheets, and toast messages.
- [Mob.Canvas](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Canvas.md): Drawing-op constructors for `Mob.UI.canvas/1`.
- [Mob.Certs](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Certs.md): CA-certificate loading for mob apps. Companion to `Mob.DNS` — same
shape: a small wrapper documenting and working around something OTP
assumes about the OS that Android doesn't satisfy.
- [Mob.Component](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Component.md): Behaviour for native view components.
- [Mob.DNS](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.DNS.md): Hostname → IP resolution that works around BEAM's broken DNS path
on iOS and physical Android devices.
- [Mob.Device](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Device.md): Cross-platform device events and queries.
- [Mob.Device.Android](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Device.Android.md): Android-specific device events. Symmetrical with `Mob.Device.IOS`.
- [Mob.Device.IOS](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Device.IOS.md): iOS-specific device events. Subscribers receive events that either have no
Android counterpart (e.g. `:protected_data_did_become_available`) or carry
extra iOS fidelity beyond what `Mob.Device` exposes cross-platform.
- [Mob.Diag](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Diag.md): Runtime diagnostics that run inside a Mob app's BEAM. Designed to be
invoked via Erlang RPC from a developer's machine to inspect the
actual state of a deployed app.
- [Mob.Event](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Event.md): The unified event emission API for Mob.
- [Mob.Event.Address](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Event.Address.md): Canonical address for an event in the Mob view tree.
- [Mob.Event.Bridge](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Event.Bridge.md): Translates legacy event shapes (`{:tap, tag}`, `{:change, tag, value}`,
`{:tap, {:list, id, :select, index}}`) into the canonical
`{:mob_event, %Address{}, event, payload}` envelope.
- [Mob.Event.Component](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Event.Component.md): Behaviour for **stateful** event-owning components.
- [Mob.Event.Target](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Event.Target.md): Resolves a `target:` spec to a concrete delivery pid.
- [Mob.Event.Throttle](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Event.Throttle.md): Throttle / debounce config for high-frequency event subscriptions.
- [Mob.Event.Trace](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Event.Trace.md): Live tracing of Mob events for IEx debugging.
- [Mob.LiveView](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.LiveView.md): Bridge between Phoenix LiveView and the Mob native WebView.
- [Mob.Registry](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Registry.md): Maps component names (atoms) to their platform-specific NIF constructors.
- [Mob.ScreenCase](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.ScreenCase.md): The blessed way to unit-test a `Mob.Screen` in the BEAM, no device or
emulator required. The screen-level analog of `Phoenix.LiveViewTest`.
- [Mob.ScreenCase.View](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.ScreenCase.View.md): A screen under test. Two backends, same query/assertion surface
- [Mob.Speech](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Speech.md): Text-to-speech. No permission required on either platform.
- [Mob.Storage](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Storage.md): App-local file storage.
- [Mob.Storage.Android](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Storage.Android.md): Android-specific storage locations and MediaStore integration.
- [Mob.Storage.Apple](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Storage.Apple.md): iOS-specific storage locations and media library integration.
- [Mob.Theme.AdaptiveWatcher](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Theme.AdaptiveWatcher.md): GenServer that re-resolves the active theme when the OS appearance flips.
- [Mob.VendorUsb](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.VendorUsb.md): Raw USB host access via vendor bulk endpoints. **Android only.**
- [Mob.WebView](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.WebView.md): Bidirectional JS bridge for the native WebView component.

- Core
  - [Mob](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.md): Mob — BEAM-on-device mobile framework for Elixir.
  - [Mob.App](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.App.md): Behaviour for Mob application entry point.
  - [Mob.Screen](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Screen.md): Behaviour and GenServer wrapper for a Mob screen.
  - [Mob.ScreenState](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.ScreenState.md): Persistent store for screen assigns.
  - [Mob.Socket](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Socket.md): The socket struct passed through all Mob.Screen and Mob.Component callbacks.
  - [Mob.State](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.State.md): Persistent key-value store for app state.

- UI
  - [Mob.Composite](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Composite.md): Pure-Elixir composite components: the third expansion pass.
  - [Mob.Renderer](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Renderer.md): Serializes a component tree to JSON and passes it to the platform NIF in
a single call. Compose (Android) and SwiftUI (iOS) handle diffing and
rendering internally.
  - [Mob.Style](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Style.md): Thin wrapper around a props map for named, reusable styles.
  - [Mob.Theme](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Theme.md): Design token system for Mob apps.
  - [Mob.Theme.Adaptive](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Theme.Adaptive.md): Theme that follows the OS-level light / dark setting.
  - [Mob.Theme.Dark](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Theme.Dark.md): High-contrast greyscale dark theme.
  - [Mob.Theme.Light](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Theme.Light.md): High-contrast greyscale light theme.
  - [Mob.UI](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.UI.md): UI component constructors for the Mob framework.

- Navigation
  - [Mob.Nav.Registry](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Nav.Registry.md): ETS-backed registry mapping screen name atoms to their modules.

- Plugins
  - [Mob.Plugins](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Plugins.md): On-device access to the activated plugins' tier-3/4 contributions.
  - [Mob.Plugins.Lifecycle](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Plugins.Lifecycle.md): Dispatches OS foreground/background transitions to the tier-4 plugins'
`lifecycle.on_resume` / `lifecycle.on_background` hooks.
  - [Mob.Plugins.Supervisor](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Plugins.Supervisor.md): Supervises the tier-4 plugins' lifecycle.

- Device APIs
  - [Mob.Audio](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Audio.md): Microphone recording and audio playback.
  - [Mob.Clipboard](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Clipboard.md): System clipboard access. No permission required.
  - [Mob.Files](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Files.md): System file picker. Opens the OS document picker (Files app on iOS, SAF on Android).
  - [Mob.Haptic](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Haptic.md): Haptic feedback. No permission required on either platform.
  - [Mob.Motion](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Motion.md): Accelerometer and gyroscope sensor data.
  - [Mob.Permissions](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Permissions.md): Request OS-level permissions from the user.
  - [Mob.Share](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Share.md): System share sheet. Opens the OS share dialog with a piece of content.
Fire-and-forget — no response arrives in the BEAM.

- Testing &amp; Debugging
  - [Mob.Test](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Test.md): Remote inspection and interaction helpers for connected Mob apps.

- Tooling
  - [Mob.Formatter](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Formatter.md): `mix format` plugin for the `~MOB` sigil.

- Internals
  - [Mob.Dist](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Dist.md): Platform-aware Erlang distribution startup.
  - [Mob.List](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.List.md): Data-driven list component.
  - [Mob.NativeLogger](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.NativeLogger.md): OTP logger handler that routes Elixir Logger output to the platform's native
system log.
  - [Mob.Sigil](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mob.Sigil.md): The `~MOB` sigil for declarative native UI.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix erlfmt](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Erlfmt.md): Format `.erl` files (or check formatting with `--check`).
- [mix mob.onboarding_test](https://mob.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mob.OnboardingTest.md): Runs the Mob onboarding integration tests, which verify that a new user can
go from zero to a running app without hitting any friction that should have
been caught automatically.
